title: Budgets, completion pings and graded credentials still need the container agent as their driver
body: reconcilerDrives (cloudflare/src/runs.ts) routes any submission carrying max_cost_usd, max_wall_clock_ms, notify or a non-write credential_grade to RunWorkflow, because the Workflow-hosted reconciler meters no spend, pings no channel and issues every worker the write grade. A plain epic run can therefore not be bounded or notified on the reconciler host. When the Workflow host grows that machinery, each field moves out of the predicate and the routing tests move with it.
